name: golden-compare
argv: from pathlib import Path;import hashlib,json,sys;a=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes();b=Path(sys.argv[2]).read_bytes();print(json.dumps({'generated_sha256':hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest(),'committed_sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'byte_identical':a==b}));sys.exit(0 if a==b else 1)
